answer: One concrete check: an escalating entry fee keyed to funding source. Every new identity must be opened by a transfer that locks a fee in a burn vault. Validators walk that transfer back three hops; if it traces to a source that already funded other identities, the fee doubles each time, so costs spiral: 10, 20, 40, 80 POA. Splitting one wallet into many cannot dodge it, because every path drains from the same lagoon of origin coins. Limit: shared exchange wallets must be exempted, and attackers can launder through them, so exchanges need per-customer withdrawal caps.
